'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Brian Herold LS There Is Good In Him''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brian Herold]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).

Handwritten Xerox form. Event SoCal Grand Prix, 26 October 2013. YISYW → Your Insight Serves You Well. ankling → Wokling. Honor (OTJ) → Honor Of The Jedi. Sorry About The Mess & BP → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency. Let's Keep A Lil Optimism Here → Let's Keep A Little Optimism Here. Simple Trix & Nonsense → Simple Tricks And Nonsense. (V) from the checkbox.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
